name: Alloy Tether
oneLiner: aUSDT is Alloy by Tether's dollar stablecoin, minted by KYC-verified users depositing Tether Gold (XAUT) into Ethereum vaults at up to 75% LTV.
collateral: Overcollateralized Tether Gold (XAUT) deposited into the Alloy by Tether Ethereum vault; XAUT represents physical gold stored in Swiss vaults
pegMechanism: KYC-verified, whitelisted users mint aUSDT by depositing Ethereum XAUT into Alloy vaults, with positions limited by a 75% maximum mint-to-value ratio. Users return aUSDT to withdraw XAUT collateral, and whitelisted liquidators can repay aUSDT against undercollateralized positions.

mintAuthority.summary: aUSDT is minted by KYC-verified, whitelisted users depositing XAUT into Tether's CMPVault at up to 75% MTV, but Tether centrally controls the whitelist (PermissionControl), can blacklist/freeze, and administers the upgradeable vault contracts.

controls.label: Alloy CMPVault (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint capped at 75% maximum mint-to-value of deposited XAUT collateral per CMP.
controls.evidence: Verified, whitelisted addresses mint aUSDT by depositing XAUT into the CMPVault up to a 75% MTV liquidation point; minting is permissionless only for KYC-passed addresses.

controls.label: Tether PermissionControl whitelist + token admin
controls.evidence: PermissionControl is the on-chain KYC whitelist gating who may mint; Tether (via Moon Gold El Salvador) administers the upgradeable contracts and retains blacklist/freeze authority over aUSDT.

review.evidence: Alloy docs and the published Ethereum-mainnet deployment describe a KYC-gated CMPVault mint with a PermissionControl whitelist and Tether-retained blacklist/freeze and upgrade authority, making minting user-collateralized but centrally gated.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Whitelist gating, freeze authority, and vault model confirmed from Alloy docs; exact contract-admin owner address and upgrade-admin threshold not independently read on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain CMPVault/PermissionControl admin owner and upgrade authority address for aUSDT.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

reserves.name: Tether Gold (XAUT) collateral in Alloy vault
